warnings: Axes: x = grids 1-9 at 3.00 (24.00); y = rows C, B, A printed top-to-bottom at 3.00. Origin C1 (top-left).

The two WC blocks above row C (at grids 3 and 7) are 1.60 deep (printed) but their width is not dimensioned on this sheet; their side walls (2', 3', 6', 7') are scaled (≈1.95 either side of the grid) and flagged.
Above row C the left chain prints 0.90 / 1.60 / 1.50 / 1.00 while the right chain prints only 1.60 to the WC block top — kept as separate lines (C'''' = 1.60, C''''' = 0.90).
Scanned set with handwritten quantity-takeoff marks in pen on several sheets (ticks and counts beside members); these are not part of the drawing and were ignored.
Only the structural sheet was swept for ticks.
